articles.title: Dutch Police Arrest ‘Reformed’ Hacker in Shiny Hunters Investigation
articles.summary: Authorities in the Netherlands have arrested a 23-year-old convicted cybercriminal on suspicion of aiding in data thefts and extortions by the prolific hacker group ShinyHunters.
